def prepare(route,cid,ext_start=True,ext_end=True,reverse=False):

def metrics(out,save=False):

+def zhang_suen(mask: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    a = mask.astype(np.uint8).copy()

+        changed = False

+            count = sum(ns)

+def skeleton_neighbors(y, x, points):

+        q = (y + dy, x + dx)
+        if q not in points:
+            continue
+        # Avoid diagonal shortcuts when the same pair is connected orthogonally.
+        if dy and dx and ((y + dy, x) in points or (y, x + dx) in points):

+        ans.append(q)
+    return ans

+def skeleton_route(sk, labels, component, start_xy, end_xy):
+    ys, xs = np.where(sk & (labels == component))
+    points = set(zip(ys.tolist(), xs.tolist()))

+    # Dijkstra on the one-pixel skeleton, preferring its true diagonal route.
+    import heapq

+    distances = {start: 0.0}
+    parent = {}
+    queue = [(0.0, start)]
+    while queue:
+        d, u = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        if d != distances[u]:

+            edge = math.sqrt(2.0) if abs(v[0] - u[0]) + abs(v[1] - u[1]) == 2 else 1.0
+            nd = d + edge
